declaration_mapping.eligible_indices: printed pamphlet Declaration indices 1..975 excluding undefined label 501

primary_statistic.positive_transition: right alphabet rank minus left alphabet rank is 0 or 1
primary_statistic.statistic: maximum positive-transition count over every contiguous 17-symbol B3 window
primary_statistic.location_selection: all windows included; no selected location

null.rule: uniformly inject B3's 263 distinct numeric labels without replacement into the eligible printed Declaration indices; preserve B3 equality pattern; recompute scan maximum

secondary_descriptive: full-stream positive-transition count, calibrated under the identical null but not used for the primary decision
excluded: no alternative window lengths, reverse alphabet walks, shifts, subsequence deletion, or post-exposure statistic selection
